title: Devin can explain any codebase
subtitle: Ask Devin answers with citations, DeepWiki maps the architecture
outro: Ask a question, get answers grounded in the code
voOutro: Ask a question, and get answers grounded in the code.

intro.vo: Devin can explain any codebase. Drop into a repo you've never seen, and just ask how it works.

how.vo: Devin indexes your connected repositories. Ask Devin searches the code and cites its answers, and DeepWiki turns the repo into pages and architecture diagrams.

0.vo: Here's an open-source repo I don't know yet, a site that explains how X ranks its For You feed.

1.vo: In the composer, switch to Ask, and point it at that one repository, so every answer comes from its code.

23.vo: Then ask your question in plain English, the way you'd ask a teammate.

90.vo: Devin searches the repo for the files that matter.

97.vo: About a minute later, it explains the scoring formula, and each point links to the exact file and lines.

104.vo: Click a citation, and the code panel jumps straight to those lines, so you can check the answer yourself.

108.vo: For the big picture, open the repo's DeepWiki. Each page explains a part of the system and lists the source files behind it.

112.vo: Its diagrams map the architecture onto real files, from the React app to the Cloudflare Worker and the tweet dataset.

uses.vo: Use it to onboard onto a new repo, explore unfamiliar code, or plan a feature. Then start a Devin session straight from the answer, with all that context.
